name: refactor
description: Investigate, refactor, test and review, without changing behaviour.

tasks.title: Investigate the current shape
tasks.instruction: Understand the current shape of the code involved in: {goal}. Report what exists today and what makes it awkward, with file and line references. Do not change any files.

tasks.title: Refactor
tasks.instruction: Refactor the code described in the findings. Preserve behaviour exactly — this is a structural change, not a functional one. {goal}

tasks.title: Run the tests
tasks.instruction: Run the project's tests and confirm behaviour is unchanged. Quote any real failure output; never report a pass you did not observe.

tasks.title: Review the refactor
tasks.instruction: Review the diff and confirm no observable behaviour changed. Give a concrete failing scenario for each finding. End with exactly one line: 'VERDICT: approved' or 'VERDICT: changes-requested'.
